INSTRUCTIONS: Reference in a run file as: terrain/desert/my_desert
_SCOPE_NOTE: Terrain files now own PHYSICAL parameters only (heightmap shape, clutter intensity, atmospheric refraction). Degradation TOGGLES (terrain_occlusion, horizon_masking, ground_clutter, doppler_fade, weather) live in the run file's 'degradation' block — see config/runs/run_template.json. This separation was cleaned up in v3.4.3 to prevent silent overrides.
